name: qimam-bge-reranker-v2-m3-kb
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: cross-encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full bidirectional attention over query+passage
notes: ADDED 2026-11-02. A finetune of BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.568 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-10-07. CAVEAT: single training run, no hyperparameter sweep, on synthetic single-company Arabic/English data (1,438 rows). Test split is 238 questions reranking a 30-candidate fused pool; the reranker and pool were chosen on validation nDCG@10 only, so the test rows carry a light selection bias. The base reranker actually LOWERS quality after the domain-tuned embedder (test nDCG@10 0.9649 vs 0.9763 for no reranker), so the honest reading of these rows is 'fine-tuning recovers what the generic cross-encoder lost on this domain and adds ~1.2 points', not 'a generic reranker is beaten from scratch'. Card also warns scores are saturated (BCE with pos_weight=4), so the margins are compressed near the top of the range. FLOPs per active token set to 1.14e+09 (= 2 * active_params_b * 1e9, SCHEMA.md:543) rather than the generator's 6e9 coefficient, which is a 3x overstatement still live in tools/mk_finetune_record.py:251; value overwritten from base record bge-reranker-v2-m3.
